# hevo_destination (Resource)

A Destination: the warehouse or database Pipelines load into. Hevo tests the connection on create and on every config change, and refuses a Destination it cannot reach.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hevo_destination" "snowflake" {
  name         = "Snowflake"
  connector_id = "snowflake"

  # Keys and value types follow the connector's schema:
  # data "hevo_connector_metadata" with connector_id = "snowflake".
  config = {
    account_url = "acme.snowflakecomputing.com"
    warehouse   = "LOAD_WH"
    database    = "ANALYTICS"
    username    = "HEVO"
    password    = var.snowflake_password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Dynamic) The connector's settings, as its schema in the `hevo_connector_metadata` data source names them. Credentials are write-only: Hevo masks them in every read, so the provider keeps the value you set. Only the keys you set are compared for drift.
- `connector_id` (String) The destination connector, for example `snowflake`. List them with the `hevo_connectors` data source. Changing it replaces the Destination.
- `name` (String) The Destination's display name, unique within the team.

### Optional

- `force_delete` (Boolean) Delete the Destination even when Pipelines load into it, deleting those Pipelines and their Sources too. Destination tables are kept. Without it, destroying a Destination that Pipelines still use fails and names them. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the Destination was created, in RFC 3339.
- `created_by` (String) Who created the Destination.
- `id` (String) The Destination's id.
- `status` (String) The Destination's status, for example `CREATED`.
- `type` (String) The destination type, for example `SNOWFLAKE`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Destination was last changed, in RFC 3339.
- `updated_by` (String) Who last changed the Destination.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Destination by its numeric id. Credentials are never read back: add them to config
# before the next apply.
terraform import hevo_destination.snowflake 7
```
